speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Oppositional Defiant Disorder (ODD). The patient presents with a 9-year-old male exhibiting a persistent pattern of defiant and uncooperative behavior (e.g., refusing directed activities, verbal rebellion) specifically in structured settings like class and gym, while maintaining positive peer relationships and engaging in spontaneous physical activities during recess. This pattern is consistent with ODD, as the defiance is situational rather than global or accompanied by the hyperactivity/impulsivity required for ADHD. No further questions are needed; I will proceed with the diagnosis.
